title: {Syn} LIGO Heard Space-Time Ring
content:
LIGO first directly detected gravitational waves in 2015 from a merger of two black holes, confirming a major prediction of general relativity.

The measurement was tiny but profound: laser interferometers sensed changes in distance far smaller than a proton over kilometer-scale arms.

Why it matters: science facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
